args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when
parsing deeply nested arrays, high severity). Fixed in 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.
- fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Per the advisory, versions <2.9.4 (and 3.0.x) are affected; 2.9.4 is the first fixed version.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.
